title: Lantern Lake Fishing [left in English; not translated into Burmese]
hud.cast: Throw (cast) [literally 'to throw down / drop'; a generic verb, out of context it could read as 'throw away']
rarity.mythic: Myth / mythology (literally 'spirit legend') [a noun, not an adjective like 'mythic'; it contains the word for 'legend', so it may be hard to tell apart from a Legendary tier]
pass.lucky_bait: Lucky Bait doubles your chance of catching rare fish!
ascend.button: Upgrade / level up [literally 'raise the level/rank'; the everyday word for an upgrade, nothing in it suggests a reset]
ascend.confirm: Upgrade (level up) now? You will have to start over from the beginning, but you will catch {bonus}% more rare fish.
weather.storm: A storm is coming! Rare fish are biting now.
quest.title: Mission
quest.catch_n: Catch {n} fish at Moonlight Cove [Burmese has no capitals, so it is unclear whether this is a named place or just 'the moonlit bend of the shore']
friends.boost: Fish with friends and you get +{percent}% luck
codes.redeemed: Code successful! Enjoy your reward. [literally 'the code has succeeded', slightly awkward; 'enjoy' is a wish form, 'may you be happy with the reward']
afk.kicked: You stayed without moving for a long time, so fishing has stopped.
settings.back: Back (towards the rear) [formal wording; the root word also means 'next / later', so it could be misread as 'Next']
settings.sfx: Sound [generic 'sound / voice'; does not say sound effects as opposed to music]
event.ends: {time} left until it is finished [no subject; could read as time left for you to finish something rather than the event ending]
daily.streak: Day {day} in a row! Come back tomorrow to get another reward, okay!
tip.night: Tip: Some fish only bite at night.
group.join: Join the Community and get 50 bait for free! [the word 'Community' is left in English, in Latin script, mid-sentence]
